title: Would the Answer Emerge?
paragraphs: “Keeping you by me, The fiery sun felt cool;
Parted from you The cool moon did scorch me.
We bared out our hearts And communicated with each other.
Without pouncing upon me, much like a tiger, Do give a thought to my parents’ concern for my state.
Our clandestine love career has been exposed. The entire town is resounding with words of scandal about us.
I conveyed to you my willingness to elope with you. But you insisted upon marriage to the knowledge of one and all.
Let the act of caressing cheeks and stamping on them follow later.

Tell me what your response to my concern is! Is it elopement or immediate marriage? Why do you enact a dumb skit? Would your lips remain glued for ever? Would they refuse to open even for an instant to answer my question? Do come out with an answer, at least before my death,” she said in despair.
He said, “You know how to read, Look here, the wedding invitation on the palmyra leaf.”

> The heroine’s mindscape encompasses: > Privileging her right of love for the hero, > Apprehension of separation by the hero, > Fear of her clandestine love career > Coming to be inferred by folks > And becoming the subject of idle talk around, > Her longed for rendezvous with the hero > Running into impediments, > Willing desire to go on elopement with the hero, > And wanting the hero to take her in marriage.
